title: Assembly, Annotation, Quantification, and Differential Expression Analysis of Shorea sp. Transcriptome
author: Ahmad Husaini AHS Suhaimi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b2iqqcdw
materials: Obtain the assembly statistics $TRINITY_HOME/util/TrinityStats.pl Trinity.fasta > Assembly_stats.txt

steps.title: Assemble reads with Trinity
steps.instruction: Run Trinity to assemble paired‑end reads: `Trinity --seqType fq --max_memory 245G --left reads.PAPER1.left.fq --right reads.PAPER1.right.fq --CPU 20 --trimmomatic --monitoring > runPAPER1.log 2>&1 &`.

steps.title: Blast nucleotide transcripts against Arabidopsis proteome
steps.instruction: Search the non‑redundant nucleotide transcripts against the Arabidopsis thaliana proteome using blastx: `blastx -query Trinity_reduced_output.fasta -db Araport11_genes.201606.pep.fasta -evalue 1e-10 -num_threads 33 -max_taget_seqs 1 -outfmt 6 -out blastx_trasncript_aradb_e10.outfmt6`.

steps.title: Annotate protein sequences with InterProScan
steps.instruction: Run InterProScan on the non‑redundant protein sequences to query Pfam, PANTHER, GO and KEGG: `./interproscan.sh -i Trinity_reduced_output.pep.fasta -t n -appl Pfam,PANTHER -goterms -iprlookup -pa --cpu 30`.

steps.title: Estimate transcript abundance with Salmon
steps.instruction: Align reads and estimate transcript abundance using the Trinity utility script: `$TRINITY_HOME/util/align_and_estimate_abundance.pl --transcript Trinity.fasta --seqType fq --samples_file samples_description.txt --est_method salmon --aln_method bowtie2 --thread_count 33 --prep_reference --trinity_mode --coordsort_bam`.

steps.title: Generate count and expression matrices
steps.instruction: Create matrices of raw counts and normalized values: `$TRINITY_HOME/util/abundance_estimates_to_matrix.pl --est_method salmon --out_prefix Paper1_comORF_cdhit_only_c1 --name_sample_by_basedir leaf_1312_rep1/quant.sf leaf_1312_rep2/quant.sf leaf_1404_rep1/quant.sf leaf_1404_rep2/quant.sf leaf_1406_rep1/quant.sf leaf_1406_rep2/quant.sf --gene_trans_map Paper1_comORF_cdhit_only_c1.fasta.gene_trans_map`.

steps.title: Run pairwise differential expression analysis
steps.instruction: Perform pairwise comparisons between time points with DESeq2: `$TRINITY_HOME/Analysis/DifferentialExpression/run_DE_analysis.pl --matrix quant.sf/gene.counts.matrix --method DESeq2 --samples_file samples_description_DESeq.txt --contrasts contrast_DESeq.txt`.

steps.title: Extract significant differentially expressed transcripts
steps.instruction: Select transcripts with log2 fold change ≥ 1 and FDR < 0.05: `$TRINITY_HOME/Analysis/DifferentialExpression/analyze_diff_expr.pl --matrix ../ComORF_cdhit_only_c1.isoform.TMM.EXPR.matrix -C 1 -P 0.05 --samples ../samples_description.txt`.

steps.title: Identify longest ORFs using TransDecoder
steps.instruction: Extract the longest open reading frames from the Trinity assembly: `TransDecoder.LongOrfs -t Trinity.fasta`.

steps.title: Blast ORFs against UniProt protein database
steps.instruction: Search the extracted ORFs against the UniProt Swiss‑Prot database with blastp: `blastp -query transdecoder_dir/longest_orfs.pep -db uniprot_sprot.fasta -max_target_seqs 1 -outfmt 6 \-evalue 1e-5 -num_threads 10 > blastp.outfmt6`.

steps.title: Predict best ORFs with TransDecoder
steps.instruction: Predict the single best ORF per transcript, retaining blastp hits: `TransDecoder.Predict -t Trinity.fasta --single_best_only --retain_blastp_hits blastp.outfmt6`.

steps.title: Cluster similar proteins using CD-HIT
steps.instruction: Remove highly similar protein sequences with CD‑HIT: `cd-hit -i Trinity_paper1.pep.fasta -o Trinity_paper1_output -T 0 -M 0 -d 0 -c 1 -n 5`.
